snippet.title: Knuckle Creek Steam Next Fest demo is here.
snippet.description:
💥 The Knuckle Creek Steam Next Fest demo is here already... 💥 

"Claymatic Games, the developer behind acclaimed shmup Platypus Reclayed, are thrilled to announce their next game as the clay-animated arena brawling online party game Knuckle Creek".

The demo is available now and playable through Steam Next Fest 15th - 22nd June 2026. 
Invite your friends to grab a copy of the Demo or join you on the sofa, for some hilarious brawler antics!
 
Give it a Wishlist on Steam for the launch later this year!

💥 Demo OUT NOW on Steam 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4652930/?utm_source=NextFestDemoYouTube
❗️ Find out more https://claymatic.games/knuckle-creek
💬 Join our Discord https://discord.com/invite/claymatic
